summary: Frontend-only validation of the public /pp-ferronor commercial proposal page. All 20 requested checks passed: route loads without auth, 8 A4 pages (210mm × 297mm ≈ 793.7px × 1122.5px), page-cover is edge-to-edge (padding 0), matrix has 8 workers × 7 competencies + % column, all 5 legend states present, Export button visible and hidden under @media print via .no-print, inversion page has 3 plans ($0 / $1.150.000 / Opcional), cierre page contains Javier López, Eduardo Catrifol, 'Quedamos atentos...' next-step text and 'Aptiva es un producto de DoSoft' footer. No console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: PpFerronor.js is ~665 lines and contains a lot of inline JSX with static content — consider extracting each page (cover/resumen/solucion/matriz/etc.) into its own component under /pages/pp-ferronor/ for maintainability. Not blocking.
Mock matrix data (MOCK_WORKERS, MOCK_COMPETENCIES) lives inside the page module. If reused elsewhere, extract to a data file. Acceptable for a static proposal.

PageFooter uses absolute positioning at bottom-[10mm]; if a page's content overflows this height it will overlap the footer. Verified visually all pages fit — but any future content additions should be tested against overflow: hidden.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public static proposal page /pp-ferronor. 8 A4 pages structure verified. data-testids: pp-ferronor-page, pp-export-pdf-btn, page-cover, page-resumen, page-solucion, page-matriz, page-funcionalidades, page-beneficios, page-inversion, page-cierre. NOTE for future tests: text with CSS class 'uppercase' will be returned uppercased by Playwright inner_text() — compare case-insensitively or use inner_html for original casing.
